name: nlp_lora_peft
title: A hand-rolled LoRA instruction-tune over a frozen causal LM, with a perplexity pass
origin: hardening round 1, domain-nlp, 2026-09-13 - the adapter fine-tune shape
note: MLV202 misses for a shape reason worth recording: the loop writes `outputs.loss.backward()` as one expression, and `.backward()` on an attribute-of-a-name does not resolve to torch.Tensor.backward. Splitting it into `loss = outputs.loss` then `loss.backward()` makes MLV202 fire (finding NLP-04). MLV301 and MLV501 fire only under --dataflow ip.

expected.defect: the per-projection adapters live in a plain dict comprehension rather than an nn.ModuleDict
expected.why: none of the LoRA projections is registered on AdapterStack, so adapters.parameters() is empty, the optimizer is built over nothing, and the run reports a falling loss only because the base model was never frozen in the forward path

expected.defect: the batch loop computes gradients and never calls optimizer.step()
expected.why: every gradient is zeroed at the top of the next iteration, so three epochs of instruction tuning change no weight at all and the script still prints one line per epoch

expected.defect: the model is moved to cuda but the batch tensors never are
expected.why: a CPU tensor fed to a CUDA module raises at run time

expected.defect: the perplexity pass is wrapped in torch.no_grad() but never calls model.eval()
expected.why: GPT-2's attention and residual dropout stay active, so the perplexity reported is systematically worse than the model's and moves between runs

expected.defect: the adapter module is pickled rather than its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the lora.AdapterStack class path, so it stops loading as soon as the module is renamed or moved

expected.defect: the only seed in the project is the datasets split's seed=7; nothing seeds torch, so the adapter initialisation and the dropout masks move between runs
expected.why: two LoRA runs of this script are not comparable, which is exactly what an adapter sweep needs them to be

forbidden.why: optimizer.zero_grad() is the first statement of the batch loop (line 48)
the perplexity loop sits inside with torch.no_grad() (line 63) - the defect there is the missing eval(), not a retained graph
the evaluation loader passes shuffle=False explicitly (line 59)
both nn.Module subclasses call super().__init__() on the first line of __init__ (lines 23 and 39)
trainable_parameters returns a list of Parameters, not of modules, and it is not assigned to self
no HuggingFace Trainer is constructed in this project
no class metric is computed anywhere; the only number is a perplexity from the model's own loss

unsupported.defect: the AdapterStack is optimised but never wired into the base model's forward, so the gradient path from the loss to the adapters does not exist and the adapters cannot move even if step() were called
unsupported.why: no rule models 'a module whose parameters are optimised but which never appears in the forward path'; MLV211 is the nearest later-tier code and it is about a model rebound after the optimizer is built

unsupported.defect: the frozen base weight is set inside each adapter, but load_base() also freezes every base-model parameter, so nothing in the project is trainable except the adapters that are not registered
